scope: Existing approved public Bible resources only; no new third-party collection rights are asserted.

scripture.title: Berean Standard Bible
scripture.selection: Choose a verse, passage, or whole chapter using bible-books.json bounds. Add only after the visitor explicitly chooses it.
scripture.fidelity: Use exact returned BSB verse text. Do not generate, paraphrase, or fill missing Scripture. This package does not vendor the Bible or claim offline coverage.

stories.title: Visitor-selected BSB Stories
stories.methodCredit: Story-learning method adapted from Dr. Larry Dinkins’ teaching.
stories.selection: Fresh visitors choose exact BSB passages and optional personal outlines. No preselected story collection is supplied.
stories.compatibility: Exact former public story metadata is used only to retain or restore already-touched legacy progress.

sources.title: Tyndale Open Study Notes
sources.attribution: Adapted from Tyndale Open Study Notes. The original work by Tyndale House Publishers is available for free at https://www.tyndaleopenresources.com/.

sources.title: Tyndale Open Bible Dictionary
sources.attribution: Adapted from Tyndale Open Bible Dictionary. The original work by Tyndale House Publishers is available for free at https://www.tyndaleopenresources.com/.

sources.title: CrossReferences.org · BSB cross-references
sources.attribution: CrossReferences.org, Cross-References Data, BSB TSV. Based on the Treasury of Scripture Knowledge, with the project’s own curation and BSB mapping; not a verbatim reproduction of TSK.

study.changesNotice: Original publisher wording is retained in inert JSON paragraph structures with display formatting and chapter indexes. Tyndale-derived adapted data remains CC BY-SA 4.0; CrossReferences.org mapping remains CC BY 4.0. No publisher endorsement is implied.
limitations: Dictionary associations are selective, not a complete lexical concordance.
Honest empty lists and original source-reference exceptions must remain visible.
Maps, pictures, charts, and supplemental textboxes are not included.
Do not manufacture summaries, definitions, commentary, or cross-reference explanations.

audio.mode: Reuse the existing approved public player and streaming sources; no new recordings or rehosting are introduced by this catalog.
